tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind panels and tables. Evolved from the current --background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, table bodies, inputs. Evolved from --surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, the sidebar, read-only field wells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the Ask bar while focused. Pair with shadow-pop.

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: Behind a Source File page in the document viewer, so the page reads as a sheet lying on a desk.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The rendered document page. Stays light in the dark theme (dimmed, not inverted): scans are paper and must look like the original.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and panels. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, the drop zone outline. 3:1 on surface and canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface, surface-sunken and surface-raised. Kept from --foreground.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, hints, column headers, on every surface. Darker than the old --muted so it holds 4.5:1 on surface-sunken too.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ledger blue, kept from the current --accent. Primary action fill, links, the selected row marker, focus ring. As text, on canvas, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button and link hover.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected table row, active nav item, info notices. Holds accent text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill (primary button). Never literal white in dark.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: Marker ochre: the AI's voice. Text and icons for anything the AI proposed and a human has not approved yet. On surface, canvas and ai-soft.

tokens.name: ai-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an AI-proposed value, the AI suggestion card, the Ask bar answer. Holds ai and ink text.

tokens.name: ai-mark
tokens.usage: The highlighter. Fills the region on the paper the AI read a value from (at 45% opacity) and the small AI chip. Same in both themes because it sits on paper. Text on it is ink-on-mark.

tokens.name: ai-edge
tokens.usage: Outline of an extraction region on the paper; 3:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-on-mark
tokens.usage: Text on ai-mark and on paper overlays. Dark in both themes because paper and the marker stay light.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Approved Documents, passed checks. As text, on surface, canvas and success-soft. Always with a check icon or the word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Approved badge background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs review, Duplicate Warning, low-confidence values. Burnt orange, kept away from ai ochre by lightness. Always with an icon or the word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge and notice background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, validation messages. Kept from --danger.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error notice and failed-extraction badge background.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links; an alias of accent.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour; see the focus-ring shadow.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Geist from Google Fonts (latin-ext covers Czech). Dense by default: an ERP is scanned, not read.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One headline figure per screen: VAT payable for the Reporting Period.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Supplier name in a row, button labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels above a panel section. Sparingly.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: Amounts, identifiers and hashes. Tabular by nature, so columns align without font-feature tricks.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Money in tables and the Rate Breakdown. Right-aligned. Negative with U+2212.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Document total in the review panel.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: VAT ID, IČO, variable symbol, SHA-256 hash.

spacing.note: 4px base. The current UI's 0.5 / 0.75 / 1 / 1.5 / 2rem steps map onto space-2 / 3 / 4 / 6 / 8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between a label and its input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding, between fields in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, page side gutter at phone width.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between field groups in the review panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections, page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a page title, around empty states.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

radius.note: Kept from the current UI: 6px controls, 10px containers.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, extraction regions on the paper, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, the document viewer, the drop zone.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Confidence pips, avatars, the Ask bar.

size.note: Control and row heights. Compact is the default density.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs inside table rows and toolbars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The Ask bar, sign-in form controls.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Table row height, default.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Table row height on touch or by user preference.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the navigation sidebar on desktop.

tokens.name: review-panel
tokens.usage: Width of the extracted-data panel beside the document viewer.

shadow.note: Borders do the separating; shadows only lift what floats.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: The document page on the desk.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the focused Ask bar.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a canvas-coloured gap, then a solid accent ring (6:1 or better).
